identificationModule.briefTitle: Bendamustine Hydrochloride Injection for Previously Untreated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
identificationModule.officialTitle: Study of Bendamustine Hydrochloride Injection in Previously Untreated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Patients

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether bendamustine is effective in the treatment of initial treatment of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL).

armGroups.label: Bendamustine Hydrochloride Injection
armGroups.description: d1-d2,i.v.gtt, 100mg/m2/d, 28 days per cycle, at most 6 cycles.

armGroups.label: Chlorambucil
armGroups.description: d1-d2, d15-d16, p.o., 0.4mg/kg/day, 28 days per cycle, at most 6 cycles(if WBC≥4×109 /L at d12-d14 ); d1-d2, p.o., 0.4mg/kg/day, 28 days per cycle, at most 6 cycles(if WBC\<4×109 /L at d12-d14 );

locations.facility: Hematologic hospital of Chinese academy of medical sciences
